status: Fixed and verified in source and frozen runner; formal backlog closeout recorded 2026-09-01
area: Fuzzy pending-worktree matching can deadlock a task claim before an adapter projection is audited
finding: The next-route pending-worktree check treated two-token title, plan, or filename resemblance as proof that a tracked file belonged to the candidate task. A source-first adapter-projection task could therefore be blocked before claim by generated editor files that were not yet declared in its exact scope. The matcher had discovered a plausible candidate, but the claim gate treated discovery evidence as mutation authority. This is distinct from task-direction scope enforcement: the observed failure happens before a task can run the compiler or installer that would enumerate the exact projection set.
expectedBehavior: Fuzzy task-artifact resemblance remains visible as advisory preflight evidence. It must not require scope expansion or grant write authority. A task may mutate a projection only after the compiler or installer emits its exact paths and the task explicitly adds those paths to its direction lock and work-admission ticket. Untracked and tracked foreign WIP remain non-mutating; scope and ticket checks remain fail-closed at every write boundary.
evidenceOrRepro: Focused regression tests/cli/pending-task-artifact-scope.test.ts creates a tracked .github/instructions/adapter-projection.instructions.md whose filename and task title overlap on adapter/projection. Before the repair it appears in scopeExpansionRequiredFiles and blocks claim. After the repair it appears in advisoryTrackedFiles while scopeExpansionRequiredFiles remains empty. The existing exact-stem case for docs/governance/error-code-registry.json is covered by the same test. npm run typecheck passes.
followUp: The focused pending-task-artifact-scope regression passes on current HEAD. The matching repairs 7710e8554c53e13037d4cc27e4b9941628570ff8 and 82d1efcee2292d45c4c328cc39fb030fe70032f6 are both ancestors of frozen-runner build f939a9f3810d76474f139a27dc278bf9ef4d49fc, so the published frozen payload includes the fix. Use TASK-SKL-0040 to refresh projections only after normal claim admission succeeds; do not force-add unknown templates, hand-edit installed copies, or use advisory data as an allowlist.
